about: Synthetic 8-h nights for SPEC 7.7. Times: UTC epoch ms; second index s = (t - start)/1000. Primary interpretation = prev/span/none; see FORMAT.md.

membership.span: all seconds from an event start to its latest loud second are inside

undefined_B.hold: < 60 usable seconds -> keep the last defined B

nights.name: quiet-steady-none
nights.note: Quiet bedroom, LAeq 28 +-0.8 dB, LAFmax up to +2.8 dB: nothing to detect.

nights.name: gradual-traffic-none
nights.note: Traffic rises 27 -> 44 dB(A) over 2 h (0.14 dB/min) and stays; cars every 2 min only +4..5 dB above LAeq: the running L90 follows, nothing reaches B + 10.

planted.note: gradual rise, must NOT be an event

nights.name: subfloor-and-edges-none
nights.note: Very quiet room (20 dB). Knocks reach LAFmax 34.9 >= B+10 but < 35 floor; handling bangs at 3-4 s, 40 s (warm-up) and in the last 10 s: none may start an event.

planted.note: first/last 10 s or warm-up: NOT an event
first/last 10 s or warm-up: NOT an event
first/last 10 s or warm-up: NOT an event
first/last 10 s or warm-up: NOT an event
first/last 10 s or warm-up: NOT an event

nights.name: short-bangs
nights.note: Door slams and bangs (1-2 s) on a 30 dB background; one 2-s bang followed after 2 quiet s by another -> merged.

10.merge_decision: merged across quiet runs of 2 s (each <= 10)

nights.name: exact-boundaries
nights.note: Noise-free background (B exactly 30.0, later 24.0): threshold equality, merge at exactly 10 vs 11 quiet seconds, the 35 floor, and SPEC E6 (75-s event, LAeq 49.70).

planted.note: SPEC E6: 60 s at 50, 5 s at 30, 10 s at 50 -> one event of 75 s, LAeq 49.70
B = 24.0: LAFmax 34.9 >= B+10 but < 35 -> not loud
10 s loud, 11 quiet, 5 s loud -> TWO events

10.merge_decision: merged across quiet runs of 10 s (each <= 10)
merged across quiet runs of 5 s (each <= 10)

nights.name: low-rumble-8min
nights.note: Two low-frequency rumbles (8 min, 5 min), LCeq - LAeq 18 / 14 dB -> lf_hint 1.

nights.name: low-rumble-20min
nights.note: A 20-min rumble. SPEC 7.7 excludes event seconds from B and needs >= 60 usable seconds: after 540 s of event the window has < 60 -> literal reading: B undefined -> the event ends at 541 s; "hold last B" reading: one 1200-s event. SPEC does not say which.

nights.name: party-rising-1h
nights.note: Party music: LAeq rises 30 -> 55 over 1 h, 1 h plateau, stops at 00:30. LAFmax = LAeq + 8.0 dB. Loud once the rise outruns the lagging L90 by 2 dB. Literal reading: a saw-tooth of events (each cut after 540 s when B becomes undefined, the next one starting when B lags again); hold-B reading: one event for the whole party.

planted.note: gradual rise then plateau; expected list depends on interpretation (see variants)

10.merge_decision: merged across quiet runs of 2, 2, 8, 1, 1, 2, 1, 1, 2, 1, 1, 2, 1 s (each <= 10)
merged across quiet runs of 9, 4, 6, 6, 2, 4, 4, 8, 2, 1, 1 s (each <= 10)
merged across quiet runs of 5, 2, 2, 2, 6, 1, 3, 2, 2 s (each <= 10)
merged across quiet runs of 3, 7, 2, 1, 5, 2, 1, 4, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 1 s (each <= 10)

nights.name: overlapping
nights.note: Rumble with bangs on top and footsteps overlapping its end -> one event; music then a door 8 quiet s later -> one event; a car then a dog 11 quiet s later -> two events.

10.merge_decision: merged across quiet runs of 8 s (each <= 10)
merged across quiet runs of 1, 2 s (each <= 10)

nights.name: footsteps
nights.note: Footsteps every 3 s for 2 min -> one event; then every 12 s (11 quiet between) -> five events.

nights.name: dst-fall-back
nights.note: Clock change at 01:00Z: local 02:00-03:00 occurs twice. Events at 02:30 CEST, 02:30 CET and one spanning the change (02:59:50 CEST -> 02:00:30 CET, 40 s). Detection works on UTC seconds.

nights.name: dst-spring-forward
nights.note: Clock change at 01:00Z: local 02:00-03:00 does not exist. Event 01:59:40 CET -> 03:00:20 CEST (40 s) plus events at 01:30 CET and 04:30 CEST.

nights.name: gaps
nights.note: A 5-s frames-lost gap splits a loud stretch into two events; a 20-min interruption, then an event 200 s later; a 60-s mic-busy stretch (rows with empty levels); a 10-s route-change gap between two loud runs.

nights.name: sensitivity-high-normal-low
nights.note: Disturbances 7.5, 13 and 18.5 dB above the base: High (6) finds 9, Normal (10) 6, Low (15) 3.

nights.name: overload-partial
nights.note: Overloaded bang seconds (flag 1, values are lower bounds) and partial seconds (< 90 % samples) inside and outside events: partial seconds stay valid; overload_s counts flagged seconds.

nights.name: session-start-and-end-edges
nights.note: Loud 50-55 s is in the warm-up minute (no B yet); 60-62 s is the first possible event; an event may start at n-11 and continue into the last 10 s.

planted.note: B needs 60 usable seconds: NOT an event

10.merge_decision: merged across quiet runs of 5 s (each <= 10)

nights.name: background-step-adapts
nights.note: Heating switches on at 02:00: background 30 -> 36 dB (+6, below Normal). Afterwards a bang of 44.5 is NOT an event (B = 35.5..36), 47.5 is; before the step 44.5 is.

planted.note: LAFmax 44.5 < B + 10 after adaptation: NOT an event
LAFmax 44.5 < B + 10 after adaptation: NOT an event

nights.name: random-mix
nights.note: Slowly varying background (29..30 dB) with 14 random disturbances of all kinds, >= 700 s apart.

10.merge_decision: merged across quiet runs of 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3 s (each <= 10)
merged across quiet runs of 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3 s (each <= 10)
merged across quiet runs of 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7 s (each <= 10)
merged across quiet runs of 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3 s (each <= 10)
merged across quiet runs of 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3 s (each <= 10)
merged across quiet runs of 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2 s (each <= 10)
merged across quiet runs of 3, 3, 3 s (each <= 10)

nights.name: event-until-session-end
nights.note: Music from n-30 s until the log is stopped: end = session end (last loud second + 1). A 30-min app-killed-style gap earlier reduces the valid duration.

nights.name: long-chain-every-10s
nights.note: A knock every 10 s (9 quiet between) for 15 min. Merges into one event while B is defined; whether the 9 quiet seconds inside the event count as "inside an event" for B decides if it ends at ~540 s.
